author: musho7-dev
subject: Room setup: host picks map, players and distance; room closes when the host leaves
body:
- CREATE ROOM screen: map (only unlocked ones), 2-4 players, 300/600/1000/1500 m
- Joining needs the room's map (NO MAP on the list; the server checks too)
- Room list and room show map, distance and player count
- Host leaves -> the room is deleted and everyone returns to the room list
- Time limit grows with distance
- Fix: popups (CREATE ROOM, name box) no longer close on room-list refresh
- Fix: race-server.sh started 2 robots without 'bot' on macOS
